name: tpl-precedence-1-goal
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses correctly capture the unconditionally commanded events and orders of the task ('Move the ball away...', 'Acquire the key before...', 'Open the door... then pick up'). Existence(blocker_moved) handles the first command. Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) enforces acquiring the key before opening (matching 'Acquire... before opening'). Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) enforces opening before picking up the box (matching 'Open... and pick up'). All clauses are hard as required by the imperative verbs. The machine has a valid FINAL_STATES (u4) and no redundant or added requirements.

Acquire the key before opening the door.
Open the door before picking up the box.
